name: Noroi no Yakata no Shokushukutsu
source:
A girl from an anti-alien special force is captured by the enemy commander with the alien's awful paralyzing beam.
In the alien's headquarters, she is tortured with whips, electricity, remote control vibrator, and a tentacle-machine.
She struggles to escape, but finally she is taken to a cave where biomechanical monsters crawl...

[Edited from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ002844.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一名来自反外星人特种部队的女孩被敌方指挥官用外星人可怕的麻痹光束俘获。
在外星人的总部，她受到鞭子、电、遥控振动器和触手机的折磨。
她挣扎着逃跑，但最终她被带到了一个生物力学怪物爬行的洞穴……

[编辑自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ002844.html]DLsite English[/url]]
